thread:
Ana (Growth): Quick thread to pin the benchmark narrative for the launch email + webinar. Need one clear hero claim and a geeky appendix.
Mike P: Proposal: hero = two-panel visual. Left: throughput (tokens/sec) across configs. Right: cost per 1k tokens. Callout: p95 delta.
Drew (Prod): Add a tiny inset showing p99 for rerank (customers care about tail). Also note quantization effect in caption.
Sarah - Content: Wording idea: 'Balance latency and dollars: pick the serving mode that matches your SLA.' Short, consultative.
Ana (Growth): Can we make a safe quantified example? e.g., '~25% lower p95 for similar unit cost'  need backup.
Mike P: We have a reference run on the M-arch model showing ~26% p95 improvement with our runtime tuning at comparable $/k tokens. I'll upload CSV.
Drew (Prod): We'll include config details in the appendix. Snippet for appendix: ```json
{"batch_max_tokens":256, "concurrency":12, "kv_cache":true}
```
Sarah - Content: Webinar hooks: 1) live stress demo, 2) rerank cost breakdown (search case), 3) 10-min Q&A on rollouts and fallbacks.
Ana (Growth): Inbound flow: signup -> micro-benchmark kit (script + sample prompts) -> auto report -> SDR touch for >$5k MRC.
Mike P: I'll add a tiny calculator for tokens-per-dollar and a CSV export in the kit.
Design Bot: Uploaded hero comps to /design/bench-hero-v3.png
Sarah - Content: I'll draft two email variants: value-first (short) and tech-deep (detailed).
Ana (Growth): Action list: Mike = data + kit; Drew = configs + tail histograms; Sarah = slides + emails; Design = comps. Target: rehearsal Fri EOD.
Mike P: CSV posted to #marketing-assets.
Ana (Growth): Nice. Keep the hero punchy and put all nuance in the appendix. :rocket:
